i.norm: Verifies that {@code JavaVersion.get()} throws {@link NumberFormatException} when given a string that is not a recognised version token and whose non-numeric content cannot be parsed by {@code Float.parseFloat} in the fallback branch of the method. Input "/jo" is not matched by any of the known version case labels (e.g. "1.8", "11", …). The fallback branch attempts to extract and parse a numeric sub-string from the input; because "/jo" contains no parseable number, {@code Float.parseFloat} throws {@link NumberFormatException}.
expected: the fallback parsing path inside JavaVersion.get() cannot convert the non-numeric characters to a float and propagates NumberFormatException
